name: Kunst- & Trödelmarkt Fehrbelliner Platz
facts: every Saturday and Sunday all year, 10:00–16:00
open 26 and 27.12.2026; last day of 2026 is 27.12, first day of 2027 is 02.01.2027
on a car park between Hohenzollerndamm and Preußenpark, directly at U-Bahn Fehrbelliner Platz
covered wooden stalls provided by the organiser
private sellers, professional dealers and artists

areas: Antikmeile (porcelain, silver cutlery, old photographs, pictures, furniture), Trödelkarree (films, records, crockery, radios, clocks, 60s and 70s pieces, curiosities), Kleidergasse (clothes and accessories), Kunstmeile (art, Sundays)
no new goods, food or plants
notes: Organiser states the rhythm plus the 2026 exceptions and the first 2027 date; all dates derived from that, 26.12 kept because the organiser lists it as open. The closures sentence says '2025' but lists the 2026 dates, read as a typo. Fee not stated.

description.de: Überdachte Holzstände direkt am U-Bahnhof Fehrbelliner Platz, an denen Private, Profihändler und Künstler nebeneinander verkaufen. Der Markt ist in Gassen aufgeteilt: Porzellan, Silberbesteck und alte Fotografien auf der Antikmeile, Platten, Radios und Lampen aus den Sechzigern und Siebzigern im Trödelkarree, dazu eine Kleidergasse und eine Kunstmeile. Neuware gibt es hier keine.
description.en: Covered wooden stalls right by Fehrbelliner Platz U-Bahn station, where private sellers, professional dealers and artists trade side by side. The market is laid out in lanes: porcelain, silver cutlery and old photographs on the antiques row, records, radios and lamps from the sixties and seventies in the junk quarter, plus a clothing lane and an art row. No new goods are sold.
